steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square portrait illustration for a grounded post-apocalyptic tabletop RPG vehicle.
Primary request: a recognizably accurate M2A2 Bradley Infantry Fighting Vehicle, NOT a generic fictional IFV. Image 1 is the US Army public-domain M2A2 Bradley photograph: use the vehicle's actual silhouette, proportions, six road wheels per track, tall rectangular hull with broad side armor skirts, steep sloped front, front driver's hatch on vehicle-left, distinctly large angular two-person turret and thin 25 mm M242 cannon, twin TOW launcher attached on the turret's vehicle-left side. Keep the stock Bradley design recognizable, no tank-sized main gun. Image 2 is a STYLE reference only: match its detailed hand-painted realistic RPG rendering, muted weathering and abandoned roadside setting; do not copy its subject.
Show one complete Bradley from elevated front-left three-quarter view, front toward lower left, entire tracks, muzzle and antennas in frame with small margin. All hatches closed. Worn faded olive drab military paint, dusty steel tracks, chipped paint, restrained rust, practical intact vehicle still in service. Quiet broken asphalt road, dry weeds, gravel verge, muted warm daylight. No people, no flags, no emblems, no tactical numbers, no text, no watermark. The Bradley is the clear central subject. Make the two-man angular turret and its side-mounted twin TOW pod particularly legible. Square composition, no border.

Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: transparent top-down tactical token, M2A2 Bradley IFV, ROOF REMOVED.
Input 1 is the authoritative orthographic interior geometry: render this same plan, preserving its exact silhouette, proportions, seat positions, seat facing, empty aisle and asymmetric engine/driver layout. Input 2 is the matching M2A2 Bradley portrait for exterior identity, weathered olive paint and detailed hand-painted realistic RPG style.
Camera strictly overhead orthographic, no perspective, FRONT DOWN, rear ramp TOP. Whole vehicle and both continuous tracks visible. Genuine transparent background, no ground shadow or checkerboard painted into the image. A single complete vehicle.
Remove ALL upper hull roof, upper sides and turret assembly including cannon, TOW launcher and hatch covers, exposing the interior at waist height. Keep lower side armor, both tracks, front glacis, rear ramp sill, engine cover and lower turret basket. Precisely NINE empty seats, no more:
- REAR / TOP half: SIX troop seats ONLY, in TWO banks along the side walls, THREE on image-left and THREE on image-right, facing inward toward EACH OTHER across one clear center aisle. Seat backs against outside walls. No center seats, no forward-facing troop seats, no extra cushion at the top.
- MIDDLE-LOWER: TWO forward-facing crew seats in one circular turret basket offset toward image-left, corresponding to commander and gunner. Render at the two positions shown in the guide, not one central chair.
- FRONT / BOTTOM image-right: ONE forward-facing driver's seat and small steering controls.
- FRONT image-left: large dark engine ventilation grille, NOT a seat, NOT an additional cockpit.
Light desaturated gray-green metal interior and olive canvas cushions, scuffed practical floor with restrained texture. Body length about 6.55 m and outside track width 3.35 m. Broad angular Bradley hull, side skirt boxes, two tracks outside the hull, realistic front sloped armor. Functional, empty, no people, no markings, no text. Preserve the guide rather than inventing a different troop arrangement.

steps.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: the matching ROOF-ON top-down transparent M2A2 Bradley tactical token.
Input 1 is an authoritative ROOF GEOMETRY GUIDE over the exact painted chassis. Replace its flat-colored roof/turret shapes with detailed realistic paint matching the rest of the vehicle. Input 2 is the exact finished roof-OFF vehicle: preserve its chassis, outer silhouette, tracks, side skirts, front nose, lights and rear sill without shifting anything. Input 3 is the M2A2 Bradley portrait for the specific angular turret, twin TOW pod, thin 25mm cannon and weathered olive-drab finish.
Strict overhead orthographic view, FRONT DOWN, rear TOP. Same frame and scale as input 1 and 2. Genuine transparent background, no ground or cast shadow. A SINGLE complete M2A2 Bradley, no other objects.
Add the roof assembly following the guide geometry, not a new chassis:
- Rear half: closed angular armored troop roof and large cargo hatch. No interior seat visible.
- A LARGE ANGULAR TWO-PERSON Bradley turret offset toward image-left, centered over the round basket of input 2. Exactly TWO closed crew hatches, centers at about x32% and x51% of the frame, y58%; these must line up with the two seats below. Bradley turret shape, not a small round cone.
- Twin TOW missile launch tubes in a rectangular armored pod on the image-RIGHT side of the turret, aiming toward BOTTOM, positioned in the guide at x65–78%, y51–68%. Keep that distinctive pod.
- A thin M242 autocannon from the center of the turret pointing straight toward the bottom, ABOVE the engine deck and glacis, barrel ending before the lower hull tip; small coax and realistic optics. Do not use a large tank cannon.
- Exactly ONE driver's hatch at image-RIGHT front, centered about x71%, y75%, directly over the one driver's seat of input 2. Large engine ventilation grille on image-LEFT in front of the turret, NOT another driver hatch.
Whole exterior weathered faded olive paint, subtle tan dust, restrained chips, fine mechanical detail, consistent RPG painted realism. No people, numbers, symbols, writing or logos. Preserve underlying proportions and keep all crew hatch positions locked to the guide.

Create a peaceful tabletop RPG vehicle illustration: the closed-roof counterpart of this M2A2 Bradley model. No people or action.
Image 1 is an exact geometry sketch of the roof to paint. Image 2 is the finished open interior and chassis to preserve. Image 3 is the portrait identity/style reference. Render the flat green shapes in image 1 as detailed worn olive-drab metal matching image 2 and the Bradley in image 3. Strict orthographic overhead view, front DOWN. Same framing, same tracks, same side skirts, same front nose and same rear edge. Genuine transparent background.
The large angular two-person turret sits exactly above the circular basket, offset image-left. Its two CLOSED hatch lids align with the two underlying seats, at x32% and x51%, y58% of the frame. The distinctive side pod stays on image-right of the turret as drawn in the guide. The slender projecting front detail continues downward above the engine grille, stopping before the front edge.
There is just ONE driver hatch, image-right at x71%, y75%, directly over the driver of image 2. Preserve the large ventilation grille on image-left opposite the driver. Cover all rear passenger seating with the roof and rear cargo hatch drawn in image 1.
Match the recognizable Bradley body in image 3, hand-painted realistic RPG art, dusty weathered olive paint. No text, symbols, people, effects, ground, cast shadow or extra objects. Keep the roof placement locked to the guide.
